fullDescription:
Unleash dramatic luxury, mystical elegance, and modern editorial flair with Mister Zodiak! Designed as a high-contrast display serif, it features ultra-tall condensed stems, dramatic sweeping ligatures, and intricate swirling swashes. Packed with alternate glyphs, its haute-couture silhouette brings an enchanting, premium edge to logos and headlines.

Ideal for boutique brand monograms, luxury fashion titles, cosmetics packaging, editorial magazine spreads, astrology quote art, perfume labels, and custom Cricut or Silhouette craft SVG projects!
